test_title: PYST 1: Selection Post (Matric Level) - Quant (Held On 29 Aug 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: How many years will it take for an investment of ₹5,000 to earn ₹1,000 as simple interest at an annual rate of 8%?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹5,000

Simple Interest (SI) = ₹1,000

Rate of Interest (R) = 8%

**Formula Used:**

SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

T = (SI × 100) ÷ (P × R)

**Calculation:**

⇒ T = (1,000 × 100) ÷ (5,000 × 8)

⇒ T = 1,00,000 ÷ 40,000

⇒ T = 2.5

**∴ The correct answer is 2.5.**
